# Security (AP-SEC)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-SEC-01

**UI visibility used as authorization** — severity **blocker**, manual review (G7), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Hiding or disabling a button does not stop a user calling the operation. The browser is not a trusted boundary.

**Fix.** Enforce the policy at the server/application boundary (endpoint, application service). UI checks are UX only. Record the enforcement point in the spec authorization matrix.

**Bad:**

```razor
<AuthorizeView Roles="Admin"><RadzenButton Click="@Delete" /></AuthorizeView>  (DELETE endpoint has no policy)
```

**Good:**

```razor
app.MapDelete("/api/users/{id}", ...).RequireAuthorization("UsersDelete");  + AuthorizeView for UX
```

## AP-SEC-02

**Endpoint used by a new screen lacks authorization** — severity **blocker**, manual review (G7), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** A new UI often calls an existing endpoint that was internal or anonymous.

**Fix.** Check every endpoint in the feature trace for [Authorize]/RequireAuthorization or a fallback policy; add a policy in scope when missing.

## AP-SEC-03

**Exception details shown to users** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Exception messages and stack traces leak internals (SQL, paths, tokens).

**Fix.** Show a safe message; log the exception with correlation id; follow the repository error contract (ProblemDetails).

**Bad:**

```razor
Notifications.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Error, "Failed", ex.Message);
```

**Good:**

```razor
Notifications.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Error, "Saving failed", "Please try again. Reference: " + traceId);
```

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(Notify\s*\([^;]*\b(ex|exc|exception|e)\.(Message|StackTrace|ToString\s*\(\s*\))|Detail\s*=\s*(ex|exc|exception|e)\.(Message|StackTrace|ToString\s*\(\s*\))|@(ex|exception)\.(Message|StackTrace))`.

## AP-SEC-04

**Credentials in configuration files** — severity **blocker**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Passwords in connection strings in tracked configuration end up in source control and build artifacts.

**Fix.** Use user secrets, environment variables, managed identity or a secret store.

**Detection:** files `appsettings*.json`, `*.config`; pattern `(?i)\b(password|pwd)\s*=\s*[^;"\s]{3,}`.

## AP-SEC-05

**Radzen MCP key committed** — severity **blocker**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** The X-Radzen-Key licence key grants MCP access to anyone who reads the repository.

**Fix.** Remove the key, rotate it, reference RADZEN_MCP_KEY or an input prompt (mcp/templates).

**Detection:** files `*.json`, `*.toml`, `*.md`, `*.yml`, `*.yaml`, `*.cs`, `*.ps1`, `*.sh`, `*.env`; pattern `(?i)X-Radzen-Key["']?\s*[:=]\s*["'](?!\s*\$\{)[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]{12,}["']`.

## AP-SEC-06

**AllowAnonymous on a feature page or endpoint** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Anonymous access on a page or endpoint that belongs to a protected feature bypasses the fallback policy.

**Fix.** Remove it, or record the approved reason as a waiver.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `\[AllowAnonymous\]|\.AllowAnonymous\s*\(`.

## AP-SEC-07

**Rendering raw HTML** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** MarkupString renders unencoded HTML; user-controlled content becomes an XSS vector.

**Fix.** Render text normally, or sanitize with an approved sanitizer and waive with reason.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `\(\s*MarkupString\s*\)|new\s+MarkupString\s*\(`.

## AP-SEC-08

**Over-fetching sensitive data** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Returning full entities to the UI exposes fields the screen does not need.

**Fix.** Project to a DTO with only the fields in the spec data requirements.

## AP-SEC-09

**Antiforgery disabled** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Disabling antiforgery on forms or endpoints enables CSRF.

**Fix.** Keep antiforgery; for APIs use token-based auth where antiforgery does not apply.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `\[IgnoreAntiforgeryToken\]|\.DisableAntiforgery\s*\(`.

## AP-SEC-10

**Secrets written to logs** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Tokens and passwords in logs are readable by anyone with log access.

**Fix.** Log identifiers, not secrets.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(?i)\bLog(Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Critical)\s*\([^;]*\{\s*(password|accessToken|refreshToken|secret|apiKey|clientSecret)\s*\}`.
